title: The TI WooCommerce Wishlist WordPress plugin before 2.0.7 does not sanitise and escape user input before using it in a…
description: The TI WooCommerce Wishlist WordPress plugin versions prior to 2.0.7 contain a vulnerability where user input is not properly sanitized or escaped before being used in a SQL statement on a front-end endpoint. This flaw allows unauthenticated users to conduct SQL injection attacks.
